name: mmry
description: Mmry - memory-care companion. Next.js frontend, Node.js API, Python AI and analytics, PostgreSQL + MongoDB.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.analytics:dashboard: node scripts/run-python.mjs analytics -m streamlit run dashboards/app.py --server.address=127.0.0.1 --browser.gatherUsageStats=false
scripts.ai:train: node scripts/run-python.mjs ai -m training.build_intent_dataset && node scripts/run-python.mjs ai -m training.train_intent && node scripts/run-python.mjs ai -m training.train_difficulty
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && node scripts/run-python.mjs ai -m pytest -q && node scripts/run-python.mjs analytics -m pytest -q
